raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Megatron-LM resolves virtualenv 21.14.5, which is affected by CVE-2026-113725 and CVE-2026-113722. Both concern command execution from attacker-influenced virtual-environment names or destination paths when users activate an environment or invoke a generated launcher.

Require virtualenv >=21.14.9 as a transitive dependency constraint and regenerate `uv.lock`. The lock now resolves 21.14.13, which includes both fixes.

Validation: `uv lock` and `uv lock --check` in the Megatron-LM CI container, plus `git diff --check`. CI remains pending.

Require virtualenv >=21.14.9 as a transitive dependency constraint and regenerate `uv.lock`. The lock now resolves 21.14.13, which includes both fixes.

Validation: `uv lock` and `uv lock --check` in the Megatron-LM CI container, plus `git diff --check`. CI remains pending.
detail.title: build: require patched virtualenv on core_r0.20.0

files.patch:
@@ -196,7 +196,7 @@ no_pypi_wheels = ["flash_mla", "emerging_optimizers", "deep_gemm"]
 managed = true
 default-groups = ["linting", "build", "test"]
 # CUTLASS 4.8 moved CuTe APIs used by older Quack releases.
-constraint-dependencies = ["quack-kernels>=0.6.5"]
+constraint-dependencies = ["quack-kernels>=0.6.5", "virtualenv>=21.14.9"]
 no-build-isolation-package = [
     "causal-conv1d",
     "flash_mla",

@@ -14,7 +14,10 @@ resolution-markers = [
 ]
 
 [manifest]
-constraints = [{ name = "quack-kernels", specifier = ">=0.6.5" }]
+constraints = [
+    { name = "quack-kernels", specifier = ">=0.6.5" },
+    { name = "virtualenv", specifier = ">=21.14.9" },
+]

     { name = "anyio", specifier = ">=4.14.2" },
     { name = "apache-tvm-ffi", specifier = "==0.1.11" },

-version = "21.14.5"
+version = "21.14.13"

     { name = "distlib" },
